# OLING Management & Technologie

OLING Management & Technologie is an independent consulting firm based in France. OLING supports public organisations, SMEs and mid-sized companies with business-side IT project advisory, ERP/CRM/CMMS projects, IT governance, data, cybersecurity, compliance and risk management.

## Main Expertise

- Business-side IT project advisory (AMOA SI)
- ERP project advisory
- CRM project advisory
- CMMS / GMAO project advisory
- Financial information systems
- E-invoicing advisory
- IT governance and CIO office performance
- Data, BI and useful AI
- GDPR / DPO / privacy governance
- ISO 27001 / NIS2 / DORA / cybersecurity
- ISO 9001 / QSE
- Risk management and internal control
- Business continuity / disaster recovery (PCA / PRA)
- AI governance / AI Act compliance
